character: Sixt-Fer-a-Cheval, classified Plus Beaux Villages de France. Gateway to Cirque du Fer-a-Cheval (Grand Site de France). 16 hamlets spread across the valley. Abbey ruins. Waterfalls, hiking, Grand Massif access.
activities_nearby: Cirque du Fer-a-Cheval (one of France's Grand Sites Naturels). Hiking. Waterfalls. Grand Massif ski access (shuttle). Cross-country skiing. Snowshoeing. Via Alpina.
